**sdd/install-home-scaffold/archive-report**

**What**: Archived the completed `install-home-scaffold` SDD change — two-part feature to scaffold HOME.md on fresh installs and extract HOME.md-patch logic to an agnostic helper.

**Why**: Close the gap where `brain:env:init` advertises "Read brain/HOME.md" but nothing creates it (Part 1), and decouple HOME.md-indexing mechanics from the Claude adapter so any agent shares one tested mechanism (Part 2, implements ADR-0013 "never orphan an accepted ADR").

**Where**: `openspec/changes/install-home-scaffold/` — added archive-report.md, flipped status markers in proposal.md/design.md/tasks.md to Archived. Merged PRs #185 (Slice 1), #186 (Slice 2), #187 (tracker→main, closes #184), + follow-up #188 (closes #189, resolves REQ-7 CRITICAL via source-scan test). Main merge commit `666a5b8` (PR #187), follow-up `4759dc7` (PR #188).

**Learned**: 
- Part 1 (Slice 1) self-contained: scaffold + nav exclusion + wiring. Part 2 (Slice 2) depends on Part 1 for the empty-section insertion branch to be meaningful.
- Fresh-review fix batch caught 2 MEDIUM + 2 LOW issues in Slice 2 before PR: CRLF handling required preserving the original EOL style (not forcing LF), CLI I/O needed try/catch with clean error messaging and exit-code contract, exit-code documentation needed rows for 1/2/3, and adapter-delegation test needed positive assertion (not just negative).
- REQ-7 agent-neutrality Scenario 1 (no agent-name references) required a source-scan test to be viable — added by PR #188, mirrors the existing `substrate.mjs` pattern.
- 3 deferred follow-ups documented (same-ADR-dup-on-rename, CLI arg-shape validation, blank-line cosmetic) but not implemented — all low-risk, no blockers.
- Test suite: 822/822 pass post-follow-up merge, 0 regressions.
